commit_message: Expose ADR 0110 motion variants in Animation Set UI
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 Humanoid profiles and skeleton-independent motion. This follow-up ports explicit Auto / Native / Humanoid motion-source selection to the modular Animation Set editor, validates each persisted variant against its required imported sub-asset kind, preserves Native semantics for Animation Clip drag-and-drop, and updates editor validation coverage. PR remains Draft; merge is manual.
